_about: Known command-line AIs, ready to add from Settings › AI. Each entry is what the maker's own docs said on the date noted - their flags and model ids, not Cockpit's; they change. A preset that stops answering is a stale flag: check the tool's --help and Edit the entry. The built-in three (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Local) are not here - the engine knows them itself.

presets.label: Gemini CLI
presets.what: Google's coding agent. Free tier with a Google account; API key or Vertex for more.
presets.models: gemini-3-pro-preview=Gemini 3 Pro, gemini-3-flash-preview=Gemini 3 Flash, gemini-2.5-pro=Gemini 2.5 Pro, gemini-2.5-flash=Gemini 2.5 Flash
presets.signin: gemini  (then choose Login with Google in the browser it opens)

presets.label: Grok Build
presets.what: xAI's coding agent (the grok command). Signs in with your xAI account or an API key.
presets.install: irm https://x.ai/cli/install.ps1 | iex   (Windows)   ·   curl -fsSL https://x.ai/cli/install.sh | bash   (macOS, Linux)

presets.label: Copilot CLI
presets.what: GitHub's coding agent. Runs on a GitHub Copilot subscription.
presets.signin: copilot  (then type /login and follow the browser)

presets.label: OpenCode
presets.what: An open-source coding agent that drives many providers; the model id is provider/model.
presets.models: anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5=Claude Sonnet 4.5 via OpenCode, openai/gpt-5=GPT-5 via OpenCode
presets.install: npm install -g opencode-ai   ·   or   curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash
presets.signin: opencode auth login   (pick the provider, paste its key)   ·   opencode models lists the ids

presets.label: Qwen Code
presets.what: Alibaba's coding agent. Free tier with a Qwen account.
presets.signin: qwen  (then /auth and choose Qwen OAuth in the browser)

presets.label: Aider
presets.what: The original open-source pair programmer; brings its own provider keys, edits files and commits.
presets.models: sonnet=Claude Sonnet via Aider, gpt-4o=GPT-4o via Aider, deepseek=DeepSeek via Aider
presets.signin: no sign-in - set the provider's API key in the environment the engine runs in (OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY…)
